runtime: llama.cpp (card says standard GGUF, runs unmodified in llama.cpp/Ollama/LM Studio; mainline vs fork not stated; uses flags '-lm mmap --lazy-mode on' that may need a recent build)
method: GSQ (Gumbel-Softmax scalar quantization) per tensor + RCO (Riemannian constrained optimization) choosing per-tensor GGUF types under an exact size budget; mixed-precision GGUF. Model split in 2 shards: transformer weights (resident) + n-gram embedding table (28.8 GB, can stay on disk via mmap). Per-tensor allocation files published (tensor-allocation/*.rco-allocation.txt).
